title: Totally smells like burning wood. I think I'll stick to my white sage thank you.
text: Totally smells like burning wood. I think I'll stick to my white sage thank you.. I am a sage burner. I saw these on a documentary and decided to give him a try. Don't know if it's the brand but they do not smell at all like incense or anything like that. It smells just like burning firewood. Except you're doing it deliberately and you're doing it inside of your houme! Very unpleasant! I am not impressed with these and I will not be purchasing again. I'll stick with my white sage.

product_metadata.title: Luna Sundara Palo Santo Sticks from Peru Sustainably Wild Harvested Quality Hand Picked 100 Grams Authentic Smudge Sticks Includes a Reusable Drawstring Bag.
features: Palo Santo (bursera graveolens) a dry wood sustainably harvested in the dry forests of northern Peru. When burned, Palo Santo leaves a pleasant long lasting aroma like incense sticks or sage as well.

Recognized for a myriad of powerful therapeutic properties, including the ability to uplift mood, strengthen vitality and aid in protection. Also beneficial for concentration and enhancing creativity.
Use a lighter to ignite your Palo Santo stick at a 45 degree angle, allowing it to burn for about a minute. Blow out and waft around your home or workplace, or anywhere else you desire clear energy.
We work directly with agriculturists and farmers in northern Peru to guarantee fair-trade practices. Local communities benefit directly from collecting and selling Palo Santo.
Our Palo Santo is responsibly harvested and eco-sustainable. Our Palo Santo sticks have been certified by Peru's National Forestry Service (SERFOR). Packed in sustainable and reusable packaging.
